I have completed both requested actions for Bob Smith (bob.smith@techcorp.com):

1. **Account Disabled**: Bob Smith's Microsoft Teams account has been successfully disabled. His account status is now set to `accountEnabled: false`, which prevents him from signing in to Microsoft Teams and accessing any organization resources.

2. **Team Membership Removed**: Bob Smith has been removed from the TechCorp Solutions Team. He no longer appears in the team member list and will lose access to all team channels, files, and conversations.

These actions are consistent with standard offboarding procedures for departing employees. The user's data will remain preserved according to your organization's retention policies, but Bob will no longer be able to access Microsoft Teams or participate in any team activities.

If you need to restore access in the future (for example, if this was done in error), you can re-enable the account using the restore_user function and add him back to teams as needed.
